name: Love Crescendo
source:
The protagonist transfers to a new school and decides to join a band club, beginning their club life alongside fellow members. However, instead of the exciting club life they imagined, they face a series of unexpected events...

What kind of adventures await you?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2991980/?utm_source=vndb]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角转学到新学校，决定加入乐队俱乐部，与其他成员一起开始他们的俱乐部生活。然而，他们并没有想象中的精彩俱乐部生活，而是面临着一系列意想不到的事件……

什么样的冒险等待着你？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2991980/?utm_source=vndb]Steam[/url]]
